mechanics.description: Each round carries term, correctTranslation, decoyTranslation, and correctSide ('left'|'right'); createGateRound picks a correct item and a distinct decoy when vocabulary has more than one entry, returns an empty round with correctSide 'left' when empty; getGateSide assigns the correct gate randomly with rng() < 0.5.
selectGate increments attempts on every selection and correctAnswers only when the chosen side matches round.correctSide; no-op when status is not 'running'.

A correct selection adds +1 dragonCount; an incorrect selection subtracts the difficulty penalty with a floor of 1 dragon (lib reducer applies fixed -1 with floor 1 per DF-MECH-009; the UI loop applies the difficulty penalty per DF-MECH-023 - divergence recorded by the collector, not resolved here).
DEFAULT_DURATION_MS 30000; the game loop advances core time by TICK_MS (60 ms) per interval tick; HUD renders a progressbar with remaining seconds.

mechanics.description: Four difficulty presets - easy, normal, hard, extreme - with knobs durationMs, penalty, gameOverOnMiss; component default is 'normal'.

Gates travel from -gateHeight to stageHeight+gateHeight over GATE_TRAVEL_MS (7200 ms); at most one gate pair on screen; player lerps toward target gate (PLAYER_LERP 0.22); feedback resolves only within 1.5 px of target; playSound('success'|'error') on resolution; player returns to center after 1500 ms; feedback clears after 450 ms and unlocks the pair.

calculateBossPower returns Math.max(3, Math.ceil(totalAttempts * 0.6)); boss descends during 'boss'; bossHealth and displayDragonCount drain by 1 every BOSS_HEALTH_TICK_MS (450 ms); player projectiles spawn every 400-600 ms; boss projectiles spawn every 1200-1700 ms once bossY > 50; a player projectile registers a hit within 60 px vertical / 80 px horizontal; projectiles removed off-stage by 100 px or on hit; PROJECTILE_SPEED 600 px/s; boss sprite row switches by bossHealth/descent.
The on-canvas dragon army renders at most 12 sprites (Math.min(dragonCount, 12)).

HUD shows dragon counter (data-testid 'dragon-flight-dragon-count'), gate feedback text '+1 Dragon' / 'GAME OVER' / '-{penalty} Dragons', and the boss banner 'Skeleton King Approaches' (data-testid 'dragon-flight-boss').

The advantage-games host registers adaptive difficulty params (durationMs min 15000 / max 120000 / step 5000) and records adaptive responses with an approximate 1500 ms response time after each gate resolution.
The page requires at least 10 vocabulary items before rendering the game.

transitions.note: initializeBattle: status 'playing', turn 'player', health pools reset (enemy pool from options.enemyMaxHealth, default 100), battleLog seeded.
damagePlayer clamps at 0; only when playing and health <= 0: status 'defeat', playerPose 'defeat'.
damageEnemy clamps at 0; only when playing and health <= 0: status 'victory', enemyPose 'defeat', playerPose 'victory'.
enemyAttack: no-op unless playing and turn 'enemy'; sets enemyPose 'basic-attack', turn 'player', applies damagePlayer.
submitAnswer correct (case-insensitive trimmed match): inputLocked false, revealedTranslation null, streak+1, playerPose 'power-attack'|'basic-attack'.
submitAnswer incorrect: inputLocked true, revealedTranslation=expected, streak reset 0, playerPose 'miss'; 2000 ms timeout clears lock.
selectHero; no-op unless step is 'hero'.
selectLocation; no-op unless step is 'location'.
selectEnemy; no-op unless step is 'enemy'.
resetSelection returns step to 'hero' and clears selected ids.
Page effect resolves sprites and calls initializeBattle when step 'ready' with hero and enemy chosen.
triggerEnemyTurn rolls enemy damage via rollEnemyDamage(enemyMultiplier), sets turn 'enemy', applies enemyAttack after 600 ms.
Early-return unless status 'playing', inputLocked false, turn 'player'.
Computes damage, calls submitAnswer, plays 'success', speaks the term via speechSynthesis, updates performance, logs 'You cast {term}!'.
Submits against the fallback action ('power' or first), plays 'error', records a miss, logs 'Incorrect!'.
Page effect computes accuracy, base XP via calculateRpgBattleXp, scales by enemy multiplier, and shows the results surface.
handleRestart resets all page-local states, sets showStartScreen true, exits fullscreen.
handleStartBattle sets showStartScreen false and enters fullscreen.

mechanics.description: ACTION_COUNT = 3, BASIC_DAMAGE = 10, POWER_DAMAGE = 18, MAX_TURNS = 12. MAX_TURNS is referenced only at its declaration and as the maxTurns argument to calculateRpgBattleXp; no code enforces a turn limit.

Correct-answer damage = (power === 'power' ? POWER_DAMAGE : BASIC_DAMAGE) + Math.floor(streak / 2); post-damage enemy health Math.max(0, enemyHealth - damage); enemy counterattack fires only when remaining enemy health > 0.
scaleEnemyHealth(multiplier, baseHealth = 100) returns Math.round(baseHealth * multiplier); enemy damage range { min: 6, max: max(6, round(10 * multiplier)) } with rollEnemyDamage rolling in range.
battleEnemies defines four enemies with multipliers: slime 0.5, goblin 1, spectre 1.5, elemental 2.
battleHeroes defines two heroes ('male', 'female') with 3x3 pose-sheet sprites, and battleLocations defines four backgrounds (forest-clearing, ruined-road, magic-arena, throne-hall).

calculateRpgBattleXp computes healthRatio (weight 0.6) + turnEfficiency (weight 0.4) + streakBoost (up to 0.2), maps the clamped score to round(1 + score * 9), and clamps; final XP = scaleBattleXp(baseXp, enemyMultiplier) = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier).

tuning_knobs.name: xp weights
tuning_knobs.values: healthRatio 0.6 / turnEfficiency 0.4 / streakBoost up to 0.2; clamped 1..10 scale

mechanics.description: selectBattleActions weights each vocabulary word by MIN_WEIGHT (0.25) + difficulty, where difficulty = clamp(1 - accuracy, 0, 1); words with difficulty >= POWER_THRESHOLD receive the 'power' action.

Answer matching is exact after trim + lowercase normalization of both input and expected translation; the fallback for an unmatched typed answer is the action with power 'power', or actions[0] if none, and the miss is recorded against that fallback term.

Accuracy at battle end = totalCorrect / totalAttempts across the per-word performance map (0 when no attempts); longestStreak tracks the maximum streak and feeds the XP streakBoost; live streak resets to 0 on any incorrect answer; turnsTaken clamped to a minimum of 1.
ComboIndicator renders a 'COMBO x{streak}' badge only when streak >= 2.

A 'CRITICAL!' floating text is scheduled with probability Math.random() > 0.8 (~20%) 200 ms after a correct hit and does not alter damage; on a correct answer the matched term is spoken via window.speechSynthesis (lang 'en-US', rate 1.0, capability-guarded).
No mana/MP system (grep-verified absence); no defend/guard action available to the player (the 'defend' pose exists but no producer sets it).
The completion POST body contains xp, accuracy, totalAttempts, totalCorrect, turnsTaken (min 1), heroId, enemyId, and outcome ('victory'|'defeat').

The advantage-games mock complete route validates with gameCompletionInputSchema and computes xpEarned via calculateGameXP; the vocabulary route returns the static SAMPLE_VOCABULARY list (25 Thai->English pairs) with 'NO_VOCABULARY' and 'INSUFFICIENT_VOCABULARY' (requiredCount 5) warnings.

The page requires data.vocabulary.length >= 5 before accepting the fetched vocabulary, otherwise shows the notEnoughWords error; menuActions maps the 3 selected BattleActions to { id, label: term, power } for the ActionMenu display.

transitions.note: startGame resets the clock and spawns every word of the sentence at once at random angles with depths scattered in the lower half.
resolveHits transitions to 'defeat' when lives reach 0 (wrong-word hits decrement lives; floored at 0).
checkVictoryCondition transitions to 'victory' when targetIndex >= words.length (all words collected in order).
The shell mirrored logic phases into UI phases; victory/defeat triggered results computation (accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts, XP via calculateXP).

mechanics.description: The implemented ruleset was 'cycling-words' (Story S5, r3f_rendering_tier_20260708): every word circulates in the well; the student derives order from the translation; wrong-word hits cost lives.

updateEnemies moves enemies toward the rim at creatureSpeed/gameHeight per second scaled by (1 + laps*0.15); on reaching depth >= 1 the enemy wraps to the deep end and laps increments (rim breach wraps harmlessly, +15% speed per lap).
calculateXP: 0 XP if no attempts; accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts; base XP = correctWords; +2 perfect accuracy, +1 survival (lives/initial >= 0.5), +1 speed (bound per cited range).
ABYSSAL_WELL_CONFIG: gameWidth 390, gameHeight 700, 8 lanes, rimRadius 120, wellDepth 5; player fireRate 300 ms, projectileSpeed 400, radius 18, rotationSpeed 2.4 rad/s.
Three difficulties - easy 'Shallow Well' (4 words), medium 'Deep Chasm' (5), hard 'Abyss' (6) - and three creature speeds - goblin-scout 50, cave-spider 70, shadow-demon (per cited range).
On completion the page posted to /api/v1/games/abyssal-well/complete with xpEarned, accuracy, correctAnswers = floor(accuracy*10), totalAttempts = 10, userId.

control_surfaces.description: ArrowLeft/A rotate counter-clockwise, ArrowRight/D rotate clockwise, Space/Enter fire (preventDefault); input ignored unless playing.
Tap left of center-50px rotates counter-clockwise, right of center+50px rotates clockwise, center band (+/-50px) fires.
setRotation held-direction model: rotationDir -1|0|1 with continuous rotation at 2.4 rad/s while held; firing rate-limited to one projectile per 300 ms.

learning_goals.description: Sentence word-order reconstruction: the canonical identity is sentence/abyssal-well (AW-HIST-001); every word of the sentence circulates in the well and the student derives the order from the translation (AW-HIST-030); victory requires collecting all words in order (AW-HIST-022).

terminal_result_mechanic.description: Victory requires targetIndex >= words.length (all words collected in order, AW-HIST-022); defeat when lives reach 0 (AW-HIST-021). The UI 'ended' phase computes accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts and XP via calculateXP (base = correctWords; +2 perfect, +1 survival, +1 speed) and posts xpEarned, accuracy, correctAnswers=floor(accuracy*10), totalAttempts=10, userId to the completion API.
terminal_result_mechanic.sentence_scoring_association: Terminal scoring derives from sentence word collection: correctWords counts in-order word hits (victory condition AW-HIST-022) and wrong-word hits decrement lives toward defeat (AW-HIST-021); accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts ties the score directly to sentence word-order performance (AW-HIST-023, AW-HIST-032).
